senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; <cite ref="L00094"><he>לָבַן</he> I</cite> , v. <cite ref="L00103"><he>לְבֵנָה</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Sotah 11a:15">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 1:11">Ex. I, 11</cite>) <he>הביאו מ׳ וכ׳</he> they brought a brick mould and suspended it from Pharaoh’s neck; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 54a:8">Zeb. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שהוא שלשים וכ׳</he> a frame of thirty-two by thirty-two cubits (which was filled with stones, cement &c.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:1:4">Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13ᶜ</cite> <he>כנוטל מ׳ וכ׳</he> like taking a frame and putting it over the piled up bricks (which cannot be called building).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:1">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:15">XIV</cite>), 15 <he>מ׳ של מיטה</he> the frame (bottom) of a bedstead. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 17 <he>מ׳ של ספקלריא</he> a window frame.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:14">Tosef. B. Bath. II, 14</cite> <he>מ׳ או צורת וכ׳</he> a window frame or the shape of a door; <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:6">B. Bath. III, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 9</cite> <he>מ׳ להיות נותנו וכ׳</he> a bedstead bottom intended to be moved from one bed to another, opp. intended for one particular bed.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 13:5">Tosef. Ohol. XIII, 5</cite> [read:] <he>מ׳ שהוא מלובש וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00118"><he>לָבַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 8</cite> <he>מ׳ של מסר הגדול</he> the frame of a large saw.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 13:3">Neg. XIII, 3</cite> <he>מ׳ הבנוי וכ׳</he> a casing to protect that portion of the beam which rests on the wall.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:6">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 961:45">Yalk. Prov. 961</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 27:22">Prov. XXVII, 22</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא … במ׳</he> like one undertaking to crush barley in a frame; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַלְבֵּנִים</he>, <he>מַלְבֵּנִין</he>, <he>מַלְבֵּנוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M01478"><he>מַלְבֵּי׳</he></cite>. Neg. l. c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:12">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של פתחים</he> door frames; <he>מ׳ של חלונות</he> window frames; <he>מ׳ של כרעי המטה</he> sockets for the legs of a bedstead.

Kel. XVIII, 3 מֵלְבְּנֵי בני לוי stands for the musical instruments of the Levites; Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 9 מ׳ לוי ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.); a. e.—2) (from its shape) a small garden-bed, a plot (of three hand-breadths in width).—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>מ׳ הבצלים שבין הירק</he> plots of onions between vegetables.
Ib. VII, 2 ג׳ שורות של שני מ׳ three rows at a distance of two malbenim (six hand-breadths) from one another; Tosef. ib. III, 10.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:8">Ter. IV, 8</cite> <he>המ׳</he> (sub. <he>דבלי</he>) figs pressed in quadrangular moulds, opp. <he>עגולים</he>.
